howDoI.q: How do I make a wall my hero has to jump over?
How do I make my hero fall off an edge?
How do I make a coin that gives points?
How do I join one level to the next with a door?
How do I make a ladder my hero can climb?

pages.head: Welcome
pages.html:
Welcome

First Steps is a Starter: a small game that shows a few Game-Maker ideas, with signs in the levels that say what you are looking at. It has two short levels and takes a minute or two to finish.

Play it first. Then open it in Game-Maker (Edit a copy on the home page keeps the original safe) and read the pages below, which say where each thing in the levels is made.

The keys

Left and Right walk. Space jumps. Up and Down climb a ladder. Walk into the door at the end of a level to go on. There is nothing to fight and nothing that hurts.

pages.head: Level 1: Walk, Jump, Fall
pages.html:
Level 1: Walk, Jump, Fall

You start in the open doorway under the YOU START HERE sign. The signs along the way tell you what to try: ← → WALK, then SPACE JUMPS in front of a wall too high to walk through, and GRAVITY PULLS YOU DOWN at the edge of a plateau. Walk off the edge and you fall to the ground below. The EXIT → sign points to the door.

Coins are worth ten points each. There are fourteen, and a few of them are only in reach if you jump.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 1 is made

  • The ground. Open walk.map in the map editor. The ground is a row of the grass block over dirt. Blocks marked solid on every side stop you; that is why you walk on them and not through them.
  • The wall. Two brick blocks stacked. Open steps.bbl in the blocks editor, pick brick and look at Properties, Solid sides: all four sides are checked.
  • Gravity. The sky block has Gravity pulls set to down. While you are on a block that pulls down you fall until something solid is under your feet. Ground has no pull of its own.
  • Jumping. Open hero.chr in the character editor, Sequences (moves) tab, and pick the jump sequence. Its key is Space, it moves up once, and Moves with momentum is on, so gravity then pulls you back down.
  • Coins. The coin block has Score points set to 10 on its Touch tab, and Becomes block set to sky, so it is gone once you touch it.
  • The signs. Each sign is a few ordinary blocks side by side, with the words drawn in their pictures. Change the words in the blocks editor and play again.
  • The door. A scene link joins the door to the next level. Open steps.gam in the scenes editor and look at the links of the Walk, Jump, Fall scene.

pages.head: Level 2: Climb and Fall
pages.html:
Level 2: Climb and Fall

The CLIMB THE LADDER sign stands by a ladder that leads up to an island in the sky. Hold Up to climb. At the top, walk right across the island and off its edge: you drop onto a lower island, and then to the ground by the door.

There are sixteen coins, along the island and down the two drops.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 2 is made

  • The ladder. Open steps.bbl in the blocks editor and pick the ladder block. Under Properties, Gravity pulls is empty and no side is solid. With no pull on it, you do not fall while you stand in it, and Up can lift you.
  • Climbing. In hero.chr, Sequences (moves) tab, the up and down sequences move the hero a little each step. They work anywhere, but only a ladder holds you up against gravity.
  • The islands. Open climb.map in the map editor. Each island is a row of grass over a few rows of dirt, with sky all around and below it.
  • Falling. Nothing is built for a fall. When you walk off an island you are on sky again, and sky pulls down.
  • The exit. The last door links to the The End scene in steps.gam, which plays the ending.

pages.head: Make it yours
pages.html:
Make it yours

Try one change at a time, and play after each:

  • Draw a new platform with the plank block: solid on top only, so you can jump up through it.
  • Move the door, or add another coin.
  • Change Gravity pulls on the sky block and see what happens.
  • Make the jump higher in the jump sequence.

The home page's Starters tab has more small games like this one.

box.tagline: Every game starts with a first step.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short walks to take. Read the signs: they say how walking, jumping, gravity and ladders work. Then open the game in Game-Maker and change one.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Made to be copied and taken apart

blurb: Two short levels that teach what a platform game is made of: walking, jumping, gravity and ladders. Signs in the levels say what each thing does. It is made to be copied and changed. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a sign.

57.long: Jump. Steer with Left and Right while you are in the air.
